name: Shrinkwrapped Insanity
description: Crazy Shit, vacuum-sealed and shipped straight into your skull: breaks scrambled while the hats hop between your ears, bubble wrap popping all around your head, a cat opera with a tomcat circling you, a microwave choir whose robot rides a turntable around you, a polka split by partials under a circling air-raid siren, Chebyshev curves with a different filter in each ear, fractal melodies hopping on Thue-Morse, five tempos placed around the room, a hook hidden in noise, a talking toaster in surround and a delta-wave meltdown to finish. Every sketch is now a whole piece of roughly a minute and a half to two minutes: one song line names its sections, each track says where it plays, fills land at the ends of sections and the piece stops on its own. Nothing here is tasteful, and almost nothing stays in the middle. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume sensible.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Vacuum Sealed
sketches.description: One break, scrambled, hurried and bit-crushed differently every bar, while hats hop between your ears on a seeded coin flip, a ring-modulated bass swings from side to side on tiny delays and keyless bells strike from random places around your head. Seven sections, about 1 min 50 s, with a doubled fill at the end of every section and the bass jumping an octave in the primed seals.

sketches.name: Bubble Wrap
sketches.description: Pops at random places all around your head, near and far, while a roll of plastic unspools from a point into a wide wash and a cheerful tune drifts apart between the ears in cents, wider every bar. Seven sections, about 1 min 45 s: the tune only drifts in the drift and wash sections, and the primed drift moves it up a fifth.
sketches.source:
setcpm(110/4)
song("intro@4 pop@8 drift@8 pop'@8 drift'@8 wash@8 outro@4", "once")

// Bubble wrap: pops at random places all around your head, some close, some far
pops: s("click*16?0.6").speed(rand.range(.6, 2))
  .azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(rand.range(-30, 60)).distance(rand.range(.6, 3))
  .seed("pop").gain(bysec("intro:.2 outro:.2 *:.3"))

// The roll unspooling: identical noise in both ears, a point, opening over each section into a wash
unroll: s("pink").icorr(env("1 .05", "section")).hpf(saw.range(400, 5000)).gain(.05)
  .sections("intro drift wash")

// A cheerful tune whose ears drift apart in cents: 4, 12, 30, then a seasick 60
// The primed drift lifts it a fifth
tune: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 -1").scale("C:major").transpose(12).s("triangle").timbre("glass")
  .earsh("<4 12 30 60>").decay(.2).sustain(0).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.2)
  .sections("drift wash").variant(x => x.add(7))

// The kick and bass stay in the middle, pretending nothing is wrong
kick: s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").shape(.2).gain(.6).exceptSections("intro outro").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("<c2 a1 f1 g1>").struct("x ~ x ~").s("sine").shape(.2).decay(.3).sustain(.3).gain(.4)
  .exceptSections("intro")

sketches.name: Cat in a Box
sketches.description: Headphones on: a soprano who can only say meow sings straight ahead, a gravelly tomcat prowls in a slow circle around your head, the pizzicato sends its lows and highs to different ears and the purr sits diffusely all around your skull. An overture, aria, duet, a wilder second aria and a coda, about 1 min 50 s.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)
song("overture@2 aria@8 duet@8 aria'@8 coda@4", "once")

// The diva sings from straight ahead: mi_a_u glides across three vowels in one note
// In the second aria she scoops harder and wobbles more
diva: note("<[g4@3 c5] [e5@2 d5 c5] [a5@4] [g5@2 ~@2]>")
  .s("voice").syl("mi_a_u").voicetype("soprano").scoop(-7).jitter(.5)
  .mono(1).vglide(.15).attack(.1).release(.8).distance(1.5).space("hall").gain(.3)
  .sections("aria duet coda").variant(x => x.scoop(-12).jitter(1))

// The tomcat prowls in a slow circle around your head, once every four bars, from the duet on
tom: note("<~ [c3@2 g2@2] ~ [eb3@3 c3]>").s("voice").syl("ma_o").voicetype("tenor").fry(.6)
  .mono(2).vglide(.2).release(.6)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(4)).distance(2.5).posglide(.4).gain(.26)
  .sections("duet coda")

// Pizzicato with its lows in one ear and its highs in the other, inside a violin body
pizz: note("<[c3 e3 g3 e3] [f3 a3 c4 a3] [d3 f3 a3 f3] [g3 b3 d4 b3]>").s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .earsplit("bands").splitfreq(600).decay(.15).sustain(0).body("violin").bodymix(.3).room(.4).gain(.2)
  .exceptSections("overture").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

// The purr: the ears in opposite phase, so it hangs diffusely all around your head
purr: note("c1").slow(4).s("sawtooth").lpf(200).trem(25).tremdepth(.8).iphase(180)
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(1).gain(bysec("overture:.06 coda:.08 *:.12"))

sketches.name: Microwave Orbit
sketches.description: The choir that thinks it is a kitchen appliance, now with a turntable: a robot tenor rides once around your head every two bars, the magnetron hum rolls inside your skull and the timer dings hop from ear to ear. Preheat, defrost, two rounds of cooking and a final ding, about 1 min 50 s.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)
song("preheat@4 defrost@8 cook@8 cook'@8 ding@4", "once")

// The choir in the centre, ring-modulated and sliding a few hertz either way; it waits out the preheat
choir: note("<[c3,e3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,a2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>").s("choir")
  .syl("<ah oo ee oh>").ringmod(220).ringmix(.4).fshift(sine.range(-60, 60).slow(8))
  .attack(1).release(2).space("church").gain(.28)
  .exceptSections("preheat")

// The turntable: a robot tenor rides once around your head every two bars while the food cooks
// The second round of cooking puts it up an octave
robot: note("<c4 ab3 a3 b3>").s("voice").syl("<beep boop bip bop>").voicetype("tenor")
  .spectral("robot").samount(.8).mono(1).vglide(.05)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2)).distance(1.5).posglide(.3).gain(.28)
  .sections("cook").variant(x => x.add(12))

// The magnetron hum: the phase between the ears turns a quarter, half, one, then two times a second
// Its filter opens once over the whole piece
hum: note("[c2,g2]").s("sawtooth").irate("<.25 .5 1 2>").lpf(env("200 600", "song"))
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.12)

// The timer: three dings at the end of every four bars, right, left, right
ding: note("<~ ~ ~ [c6 c6 c6 ~]>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(3.5)
  .ild(10).earswap("0 1 0 0").decay(1.2).sustain(0).release(1).room(.4).gain(.2)
  .exceptSections("preheat")

sketches.name: Polka Between the Ears
sketches.description: The world's fastest polka, with its accordion split by partials so neither ear hears the whole thing, a tune that hops between your ears, an air-raid siren circling overhead and a rumble that opens from a point into a wash as the sky falls. A repeated oom-pah with two endings, the sky, a last polka and a fall that slows to a crawl, about 1 min 45 s. The phase rotation reaches 2.9 Hz in the last bar, so the player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Chebyshev's Headache
sketches.description: A sine tune leaps up the harmonic series through a new Chebyshev curve each bar while each ear has its own low-pass sweeping the other way, over a folded bass whose phase rolls inside your head and rectified drums split lows from highs. Lead and fold sections take turns, the primed lead is driven harder, about 1 min 40 s.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)
song("intro@4 cheby@8 fold@8 cheby'@8 fold'@8 outro@4", "once")

// One sine tune through a different Chebyshev curve each bar: the 2nd, 3rd, 5th and 7th harmonic
// Each ear has its own low-pass, sweeping in opposite directions every two bars
// The primed section drives the curves harder
lead: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 -1").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").curve("<cheby2 cheby3 cheby5 cheby7>").drive(18)
  .lcutoff(saw.range(500, 6000).slow(2)).rcutoff(isaw.range(500, 6000).slow(2))
  .decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.18)
  .sections("intro cheby outro").variant(x => x.drive(30))

// A bass folded over on itself through a stack cabinet, its interaural phase turning slowly
bass: note("<a1 a1 f1 g1>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").s("sine")
  .curve("fold").drive(sine.range(4, 22).slow(4)).bias(.2).irate(.5)
  .decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.05).cab("stack").gain(.32)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// Drums through a rectifier, half wet: the lows in one ear, the highs in the other
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8").curve("rect").drive(8).curvemix(.5)
  .earsplit("bands").splitfreq(900).gain(.45)
  .exceptSections("intro outro").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

sketches.name: Fractal Ears
sketches.description: A melody grown by rewriting rules hops between your ears on the Thue-Morse sequence, the hats are placed evenly around your head by the van der Corput sequence, toms on the primes step around you by the ruler sequence and a Collatz bass has a different brightness in each ear. Seed, grow, prune, grow again, bloom and stop, about 1 min 35 s.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)
song("seed@4 grow@16 prune@8 grow'@16 bloom@8 outro@4", "once")

// Seven generations of rewriting, hopping between the ears on the Thue-Morse sequence
// The second growth widens the pulse into a hollow square
melody: n(lsys("0", "0=0 3, 3=5 0, 5=3", 7, 4)).scale("C:phrygian dominant").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.2).ild(9).earswap(ints("thuemorse", 16)).decay(.08).sustain(0)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/16).gain(.16)
  .sections("grow bloom").variant(x => x.pw(.5))

// Kicks and snares from sieves of residue classes, kept in the middle
kick: s("bd").struct(sieve("3@0 | 5@1", 16)).shape(.3).gain(.65)
  .exceptSections("seed outro")
snare: s("sd").struct(sieve("7@3 | 11@6", 16)).gain(.4)
  .exceptSections("seed outro").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

// The van der Corput sequence spreads the hats evenly all the way around your head
hats: s("hh*16").hpf(7000).azimuth(ints("vdc", 16).range(-180, 180)).distance(1.5).gain(.22)

// Toms on the prime steps, stepping between five places in front of you by the ruler sequence
toms: s("lt").struct(ints("prime", 16)).azimuth(ints("ruler", 16).mod(5).mul(45).sub(90)).gain(.28)
  .sections("prune bloom")

// The bass counts Collatz steps; the left ear's filter wanders, the right ear's holds still
bass: n(ints("collatz", 4).mod(7)).scale("C:phrygian dominant").octave(-1)
  .s("sawtooth").lcutoff(perlin.range(300, 2400)).rcutoff(900)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.3).gain(.32)
  .exceptSections("seed")

sketches.name: Tempo Soup in the Round
sketches.description: One figure at five speeds at once, every note struck from its own place around the room, all crashing into the same note every sixteen bars, while two drummers who disagree stand at either ear and drift apart. The drummers start alone, two rounds of soup meet under a crash and the room slows to a stop, about 1 min 50 s.

sketches.name: Ghost in the Shrinkwrap
sketches.description: The off-beat hiss carries a hook that exists only between your ears (Huggins pitch), a frozen synth hints at it, a pad steps from the centre of your head to all around it and crushed clicks wander around the room. The hiss starts alone, the hint section tells you what to listen for, and the ghost returns twice more before the hiss is left on its own, about 1 min 35 s. The hidden hook is faint and differs between listeners.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/4)
song("hiss@4 ghost@8 hint@8 ghost'@8 open@8 ghost''@8 outro@4", "once")

// The off-beats are white noise hiding a hook between the ears: each ear alone hears only hiss
ghost: s("[~ white]*4").dichotic("<[440 523 659 523] [440 523 784 659] [349 440 523 440] [392 494 587 494]>")
  .dichoticq(30).attack(.005).sustain(1).release(.05).gain(.14)

// The hook on a frozen, smeared synth, once every four bars, so you know what to listen for
hint: note("<[~ a4 ~ c5 ~ e5 ~ c5] ~ ~ ~>").s("square").pw(.3).spectral("freeze").samount(.6)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.08)
  .sections("hint open")

// A pad that steps from the centre of your head to all around it, and nearly vanishes in mono
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [d3,f3,a3] [e3,g#3,b3]>").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .iphase("<0 90 180 90>").lpf(1400).attack(.5).release(1).gain(.12)
  .sections("ghost open outro")

// A centred kick and bass, with a doubled kick on the last bar of each section
kick: s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.75).exceptSections("hiss outro").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("<a1 f1 d1 e1>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").s("sawtooth").lpf(600).decay(.15).sustain(.3).gain(.4)
  .exceptSections("hiss outro")

// Clicks crushed to four bits, drifting slowly around the room
clicks: s("click*8?0.4").crush(4).azimuth(sine.range(-150, 150).slow(8))
  .distance(3).posglide(.4).seed("ghost").gain(.12)

sketches.name: Talking Toaster, Surround
sketches.description: Breakfast in surround: a saw bass that talks in syllables in front of you, a radio muttering behind the bread bin on your right, a kettle on your left whose whistle throbs five times a second, a toaster popping right behind you and a robot announcing from above that the toast is ready. The morning starts with the radio alone, the kettle and the toaster take turns, and the announcement ends it, about 1 min 35 s. The kettle pulses at 5 Hz, so the player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
sketches.source:
setcpm(110/4)
song("morning@4 kettle@8 toast@8 kettle'@8 toast'@8 ready@8", "once")

// A saw bass with something to say, straight ahead: talk puts a syllable track on it
bass: note("c2 c2 eb2 c2 g1 c2 bb1 c2").s("sawtooth")
  .syl("<[wa wa wo wi] [ya ya yo yu] [ba ba bo bi] [na na no neng]>").talk(1)
  .lpf(2400).decay(.2).sustain(.4).gain(.35)
  .exceptSections("morning")

// A crunchy, swung breakfast beat that gets crunchier on the second round
drums: s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8").swing(4).crush(10).gain(.45)
  .exceptSections("morning").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2)).variant(x => x.crush(6))

// The radio mutters on your right, half hidden behind the bread bin
radio: s("whisper*8?0.5").syl("<sha ko ta ri>").crush(4).hpf(1000)
  .azimuth(70).distance(3).occlude(.4).seed("static").gain(.14)

// The kettle on your left works up to a whistle that throbs five times a second
kettle: note("<~ ~ ~ c7>").s("sine").isochronic(5).isodepth(.6)
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(.5).azimuth(-70).distance(3).gain(.05)
  .sections("kettle")

// The toaster pops right behind you
pop: s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ click]>").speed(.5).azimuth(180).distance(1).gain(.5)
  .sections("toast ready")

// The announcement, from directly above: toast is ready
robot: note("<c4 eb4 g4 bb4>").s("voice").syl("<toast is re_a dee>").voicetype("bass")
  .spectral("robot").samount(.7).mono(1).vglide(.04).elevation(60).distance(1.5).gain(.26)
  .sections("ready")

sketches.name: Delta Meltdown
sketches.description: The end of the album: one innocent piano phrase melted four ways, four bars each, over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. The phrase returns plain once more, then the piano falls silent and the room slows down around the drone and a clock ticking somewhere behind you, about 1 min 40 s. The air of the room is wide and diffuse.
